summary: Latency-sensitive first-finish test of PitStock garage inventory app. All backend endpoints and all requested frontend flows work end-to-end.
passed: POST /api/auth/login returns JWT token (field name 'token') and user object for admin@garage.com/admin123
POST /api/auth/login with wrong password returns 401
GET /api/auth/me with Bearer token returns admin user (id/email/name/role)
Suppliers CRUD: POST/GET/DELETE /api/suppliers all 200
Customers CRUD: POST/GET/DELETE /api/customers all 200
POST /api/inventory auto-generates sku (SKU-XXXXXXXX) and 12-digit barcode
GET /api/inventory/lookup?code=<sku> and ?code=<barcode> both resolve to same item
PUT /api/inventory/{id} updates fields (reorder_point) with 200
DELETE /api/inventory/{id} returns 200
Duplicate SKU on POST /api/inventory returns 400
POST /api/transactions type=IN increments qty and updates cost_price
POST /api/transactions type=OUT decrements qty
OUT with quantity > stock returns 400 with 'Not enough stock' detail

GET /api/dashboard/summary returns all required fields (total_stock_value, total_retail_value, total_items, total_units, low_stock_count, out_of_stock_count, low_stock_items, in_today, out_today, todays_txn_count, top_movers)
GET /api/reports/movement?days=14 returns 14 daily buckets with date/in/out
Frontend login flow: /login -> fill admin creds -> redirects to / -> shows 'Workshop dashboard' with KPI tiles
Frontend Inventory: New part dialog creates a new row, search filter works, printer icon opens barcode label dialog with SVG barcode
Frontend Stock IN via /movement + 'Or pick from list' dropdown: submit succeeds, toast shown, quantity increases
Frontend Stock OUT: submit succeeds, toast shown, quantity decreases
Frontend Stock OUT with huge quantity shows 'Not enough stock' error toast
Frontend Suppliers create via add-suppliers-button + suppliers-name + suppliers-save
Frontend Customers create via add-customers-button + customers-name + customers-save
Frontend Transactions page shows IN and OUT rows with EUR (€) totals
Frontend Reports page renders KPI cards, 30-day movement chart, and Value-by-category donut (12 SVGs) without errors
action_items: Note (informational, not a bug): The stock-movement route path is /movement (not /stock). Login response returns 'token' (not 'access_token'). These are current-behaviour observations — no fix required unless the docs/spec demand otherwise.
